ruling.recommended_action: Refund the $6.61 cancellation fee to the rider as a Ryde voucher (NS-7) and close the case as driver-cancelled without a valid no-show; no account flag is required.
ruling.reasoning:
The driver cancelled (cancelled_by = driver) claiming rider no-show, so the case runs through NS-0 into NS-1. NS-1 requires all three of: (i) the driver pressed "I'm Here"; (ii) at that instant the GPS put the driver within the pickup radius (≤200 m); (iii) after the tap, the driver waited continuously >3 minutes (≥3:01) within the radius until cancelling.

(i) is satisfied: driver_pressed_here_at = 13:02:35, and arrival_confirmed_by is null in the record.
(ii) fails on the record. Using an equirectangular approximation at this latitude (111,320 m per degree of latitude, 110,860 m per degree of longitude), the pickup (1.3525, 103.9447) sits between the 13:01:30 fix (1.352103, 103.945222) and the 13:02:00 fix (1.353075, 103.944617). The 13:02:30 fix (1.352366, 103.944349), the closest sample to the 13:02:35 tap, is ≈40 m south and ≈39 m west of the pickup → ≈56 m, which passes, but the trace at 13:01:30 and 13:02:00 puts the car 60–90 m away and travelling (speed 27.9 then 23.2 km/h). The car only comes to rest at ~13:02:30. The record therefore does not show the driver at the pickup when the button was pressed — the tap precedes or coincides with the car's arrival at the kerb, and the driver's own statement ("after pressing I'm Here I waited…") contradicts the GPS.
(iii) also fails as measured from the tap: 13:02:35 → 13:05:30 is 2 min 55 s (175 s) < 3:01, i.e. under three minutes. Arrival at the pickup is logged at 13:01:00, but NS-1 counts only the continuous wait after the "I'm Here" tap; the drive-by beforehand (13:02:00–13:02:30) does not count, and the 30 s sampling grid leaves the exact time the car stopped (≈13:02:30) before the tap anyway.

Since NS-1 fails, NS-2 applies: the $6.61 cancellation fee is refunded in full (refund_full). No flag_account: although NS-2's abuse flag attaches when the driver is outside the radius at the tap (m_from_pickup_at_tap > 200), the nearest sample here is ≈56 m and a single sample does not establish the tap-instant position beyond reasonable doubt; the shortfall of ~5–25 s against the 3-minute threshold is likewise a borderline miss, so Ryde should record a policy breach without a fraud flag. Safety screening: chat, complaint and driver statement contain no threat, harassment, abuse or dangerous-driving allegation (the driver's two messages are routine pickup/arrival notices and a cancel notice), so no escalation. Confirmed fare chain per NS-0 (driver-cancelled, no-show claim); NS-7: refund issued as a Ryde voucher, non-cash, within the 30-day window (trip 2026-09-18, claim same day).

rejected_claims.reason: System records override statements: the GPS trace has the car still moving 27.9 and 23.2 km/h at 13:01:30 and 13:02:00 and only stationary from ~13:02:30, while the 'I'm Here' tap is logged at 13:02:35 and the cancel at 13:05:30 — 2 min 55 s later. The record does not support 'waited more than 3 minutes at the pickup after pressing I'm Here'.
The rider says they came out 'a minute after the driver cancelled'; the outcome does not depend on this, since the driver's own tap/cancel timestamps already fail NS-1 (iii).
